Calculation.Text: "$DefaultMasks = @('*.3g2','*.3gp','*.aac','*.aif','*.aiff','*.amv','*.asf','*.avi','*.f4v','*.flac','*.flv','*.gifv','*.m2ts','*.m4a','*.m4v','*.mkv','*.mng','*.mov','*.mp3','*.mp4','*.mpg','*.mpeg','*.mts','*.mxf','*.nsv','*.ogg','*.rm','*.rmvb','*.roq','*.svi','*.ts','*.viv','*.vob','*.vtt','*.wav','*.webm','*.wma','*.wmv','*.yuv') " & Char ( 13 ) & Char ( 10 ) & "$AllowedExtensions = $DefaultMasks | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '^\*\.', '' }" & Char ( 13 ) & Char ( 10 ) & "Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath " & $quoted & " -Recurse -File | " & "Where-Object { $AllowedExtensions -contains $_.Extension.TrimStart('.') } |" & "Select-Object FullName,Length | " & "ForEach-Object { $_.FullName + ',' + $_.Length } | " & "Out-File -Encoding utf8 " & Quote ( $outCSV )

"@echo off" & Char(13) & Char(10) & "SET PowerShellScriptPath=" & $psscriptpath & Char(13) & Char(10) & "powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File %PowerShellScriptPath%" & Char(13) & Char(10) & "pause"
